events.subject: Genesis #185 exact :8008 socket-owner and privacy hardening
events.state_before: Canonical #187 QNAP probe reconciled target-port ownership primarily at network-namespace level and could expose a full receipt on stdout.
events.state_after: Canonical probe requires LISTEN inode -> actual owner PID -> PID namespace -> Docker attribution, uses lexical process-root source identity, discovers receiver child source inside the proven container PID namespace, and keeps public stdout redacted.
events.falsification_guard: janus_nas_brain and janus_nas_api sharing one network namespace cannot make janus_nas_brain the owner unless the actual listener PID is bound to it.

events.subject: Genesis #186 resident real MODEL.CALL rejects incomplete selected branch
events.state_before: An earlier pre-reconciliation real-model run had already first-broken at TITLE_REQUIRED; a branch-complete conditional oneOf transport schema was added as a candidate fix.
events.state_after: The same TITLE_REQUIRED first-break reproduced after exact current-main reconciliation, proving that the conditional oneOf transport grammar did not solve the empirical model-output shape defect.
events.meaning: Transport and pinned model are alive; the blocker is now localized to reliable structured-output shape before the unchanged resident semantic admission gate.
events.next_admissible_gate: Replace reliance on fragile conditional JSON-schema enforcement with a simpler transport shape that cannot fabricate selected-branch content, then require a new exact-head real-model run.

genesis_pr_186.candidate_change: Simple fixed all-keys transport envelope plus schema grounding and deterministic no-invention projection into the unchanged resident parser.
